paras: There was a boy called Shankar. He lived with his mother in a village and they were very happy. One evening, when Shankar was returning from school, he saw a puppy shivering in the cold.

Shankar brought him home. “Can this puppy stay with us, Maa?” asked Shankar. “Yes beta, but only if you promise to take care of the puppy”, said his mother with a smile. Shankar and his mother named the puppy Sheru. As days went by, Sheru grew up and loved Shankar. They became best friends. They ate and played together. Sheru followed Shankar wherever he went. They played their favourite games together.

One rainy day, while Shankar was on his way home from school, he slipped on the muddy lane and fell into a deep pit. He tried hard, but could not come out of the pit. Shankar’s mother was worried when he did not come home in time. Sheru too was waiting at the gate. Shankar’s mother gathered the neighbours to help search for him. Sheru too accompanied them.

Sheru caught Shankar’s scent. He followed the scent and went near the pit and started barking. This alerted the neighbours who were searching for Shankar. They used a rope to pull Shankar out of the pit. Everyone was relieved. Shankar hugged and thanked Sheru.

items.q: What did Shankar come across by the side of the road?
What did Shankar and his mother name the puppy?

sections.heading: Write ‘T’ for true and ‘F’ for false.

items.q: Sheru grew up and loved Shankar.
Shankar’s mother was worried when he did not come home in time.
Shankar hugged his puppy Sheru and thanked him.

sections.heading: B. Think and discuss in pairs.
items: Do you remember when you fell down last time? How did you fall? Who picked you up? Share your experiences.
Do you have a pet? Do you know someone who has a pet?
If you were allowed to keep any animal as a pet, which animal would you choose? Why?

sections.heading: C. Number the sentences in the sequence of the story.
